meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: KPMG Inks $100M Global Alliance With Anthropic — Digital Gateway Powered by Claude Reaches 276K Workforce
entries.summary: KPMG and Anthropic announced a global alliance embedding Claude Cowork and Managed Agents into KPMG's Digital Gateway platform. KPMG's 276,000-person workforce gets access to Claude, and Anthropic named KPMG a preferred consultant for Private Equity AI deployments. For SMBs: this means Big 4 firms are now building Claude-powered services — expect boutique consultants and agencies to follow with SMB-friendly offerings in tax, bookkeeping, and portfolio management.

entries.title: Claude Managed Agents Add MCP Tunnels and Self-Hosted Sandboxes — Secure Private Network Access for Agent Workflows
entries.summary: Anthropic released MCP tunnels (research preview) and self-hosted sandboxes for Claude Managed Agents. MCP tunnels let agents reach internal databases and private APIs without public endpoints. Self-hosted sandboxes keep sensitive files and packages on your own infrastructure. For SMBs: if you run Claude agents that handle customer data, payroll files, or inventory databases, these features let you keep everything behind your own firewall while Claude orchestrates.

entries.title: Anthropic Puts Claude Agents on a Separate Meter — Subscription Changes Take Effect June 15
entries.summary: Starting June 15, Anthropic separates programmatic Claude usage (Agent SDK, GitHub Actions, OpenClaw) from chat subscriptions. Pro users get $20/mo in agent credits, Max 5x gets $100, Max 20x gets $200. For SMBs: if you're running automated Claude agents or skills on subscription plans, factor in the new metering — agent-heavy workflows may be cheaper on API direct access than on the new credit system.

entries.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Partner Network With $100M Fund — Consultants and SIs Can Now Build Claude Practices
entries.summary: Anthropic launched the Claude Partner Network, a formal partner program with a $100M fund for system integrators, consultancies, and technology partners building Claude-powered solutions. For SMBs: this will create a wave of local Claude implementation specialists — expect more affordable options for custom workflow builds, skills development, and integration services aimed at smaller businesses.

entries.title: n8n Valuation Doubles to $5.2B After SAP Taps It as Agent Orchestration Layer — Open-Core Workflow Tool Goes Enterprise
entries.summary: SAP embedded open-core workflow automation tool n8n into Joule Studio as the orchestration layer for its Autonomous Enterprise platform, doubling n8n's valuation to $5.2B. For SMBs: n8n is free to self-host with 1,000+ integrations — pairing n8n with Claude for skills-driven workflows (invoice processing, CRM sync, inventory alerts) is a powerful no-code automation stack without per-seat enterprise licensing.

entries.title: Anthropic Launches 'Claude for Financial Services' — Pre-Built MCP Connectors for Market Data, Snowflake, and Databricks
entries.summary: Anthropic released a comprehensive Financial Analysis Solution with Claude Opus 4, pre-built MCP connectors to financial data providers, and expert implementation support. Claude scored 83% on complex Excel financial modeling tasks. For SMBs: if you run a bookkeeping, accounting, or fractional CFO practice, Claude can now pull live market data, run Monte Carlo simulations, and validate against source documents — a full financial analyst stack at subscription pricing.
